name: Algebraic Constraint Disguise
description: Replaced the obvious pairwise inequality with a local quadratic form ($e_u^2 + e_ue_v + e_v^2$) that must not be divisible by 3. This perfectly masks the $e_u \neq e_v$ condition over the domain {1,2,3} without introducing fake global parameters, breaking pattern-matching to graph coloring while remaining a strictly local edge constraint.
